# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Bowman family  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and hired girl at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta the Fourth is a small, freckled girl with a wide mouth extending almost from ear to ear and a snub nose. She wears her fair hair in two long braids tied with enormous blue ribbons, which she sometimes styles into oversized wing-like bows. She tries to emulate Anne Shirley's light, graceful movements, though she considers herself far less attractive.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Charlotta the Fourth is an energetic, willing, and intensely loyal handmaiden who is deeply devoted to her mistress, Miss Lavendar. Although somewhat literal-minded, she accepts and respects Miss Lavendar's playful make-believe without judgment. She is prone to dramatic worrying and pessimism about practical matters or romance, yet she remains a hard-working and affectionate companion.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P67](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0067), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022)_

## History

Leonora Bowman came to live at Echo Lodge as a hired girl for Miss Lavendar Lewis, following in the footsteps of her three older sisters. Miss Lavendar dubbed her 'Charlotta the Fourth' to keep her sisters' identities straight, a name she accepted cheerfully. She performed household chores and accommodated Miss Lavendar's imaginative whims, including playing along with her imaginary tea parties. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon Echo Lodge, Charlotta helped entertain them and immediately formed a deep admiration for Anne. Over time, she confided her worries to Anne about Miss Lavendar's health and loneliness, especially after a visit from Stephen Irving's son, Paul. When Stephen Irving returned to court Miss Lavendar, Charlotta eagerly assisted with the preparations for the wedding. Following Miss Lavendar's marriage to Stephen Irving, plans were made for Charlotta to move to Boston with them in the autumn to continue serving the family.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c21 P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048), [v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P49](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0049), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c29 P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- She is the fourth sister in her family to work for Miss Lavendar Lewis  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- She was nicknamed 'Charlotta the Fourth' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion with her older sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
